about_the_game:
Dynamic Tower Defense with Roguelike Elements

Each playthrough presents a unique challenge. Build defensive systems, combine modules, and adapt to randomized enemy waves.

Flexible Tower Building System

  • Diverse Tower Types - From classic archer towers to magical spires that crush enemies with arcane might

  • Enhancement Modules - Boost tower stats and unlock new abilities:
    • Stunning projectiles
    • Arcane whirlwinds
    • And many other devastating spells

Temporary Power-ups

  • Power Runes - Boost tower combat stats: damage, attack speed and other parameters

Varied Enemies

  • Unique Enemy Factions - Each with distinct tactics and unit types

  • Epic Bosses - Formidable foes requiring special strategies

Deep Progression System

  • Talent Tree - Permanent upgrades for your defenses

  • Archetypes - Special playstyles unlocked through progression

Economy and Upgrades

  • Workshop - Upgrade and combine modules

  • Market - Acquire new modules and resources

The game features:

  • 8 types of weapons

  • 2 factions with over a dozen diverse enemies and 4 bosses, each with unique abilities

  • 16 unique spells for modules with dynamic stats

  • 6 starting archetypes

  • Endless build possibilities to crush the kingdom’s enemies!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fantasy combat with stylized violence. Some abilities may show blood effects. Enemies disappear upon defeat and do not display injuries or gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 (2048 MB) / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2048 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 (2048 MB) / Radeon R9 Fury (4096 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: You're the Tower Marshal at the Elderglen kingdom, and you have a terrible job. Your king really likes to send letters to neighbours. Ones that make them offended enough to send armies at your castle. They're already on the way, so get back to work!
